name: UGCify – UGC for WooCommerce ( Customer Photos, Videos & Visual Reviews )
author: RexTheme

sections.description:
YOUR PRODUCT PHOTOS ARE BEAUTIFUL. YOUR SHOPPERS DON’T TRUST THEM.

93% of consumers say user-generated content influences their buying decisions more than brand content. Modern shoppers scroll past your polished product photos looking for something real: actual customers, using your actual products, in their actual lives.

If your WooCommerce product pages don’t show customer photos and videos, you’re leaving conversions on the table every single day.

UGC for WooCommerce fixes this. Automatically.

FEATURES

Automated UGC Collection
Customizable post-purchase emails with smart timing.

Photo + Video Support:
Customers can upload photos and videos directly from their device.

Responsive Galleries
Grid, masonry, carousel, and slider layouts that look great on any screen.

Moderation Dashboard
Approve, reject, or organize all submissions from one clean interface.

Performance Optimized
Lazy loading, image compression, and minimal database queries. Your page speed stays fast.

Self-Hosted
All customer content lives on your server. No external SaaS dependency. No data privacy concerns.

Theme Compatible
Works with Astra, Storefront, Flavflavor, OceanWP, Kadence, GeneratePress, and all WooCommerce-compatible themes.

Page Builder Support
Gutenberg blocks, Elementor widget, and shortcode support for Divi and others.

Who This Is For

  • Fashion and apparel stores that want to show real people wearing their products
  • Home and living brands where lifestyle photos sell better than product shots
  • Beauty and skincare shops that rely on before and after content
  • Electronics and gadget stores that want video reviews
  • Any WooCommerce store that wants more trust and more conversions

Get Started

  1. Install and activate UGCify.
  2. Run the setup wizard.
  3. Customize your post-purchase email template.
  4. Choose a gallery layout for your product pages.
  5. Customer photos start appearing automatically as orders are fulfilled.

Setup takes under 5 minutes. No coding required

Privacy Policy

If you explicitly opt in to usage tracking, we collect specific telemetry data via PostHog to improve plugin performance and troubleshoot issues.

What Data is Collected?

No data is collected by default. If you provide consent, the following information is gathered:
* System Environment: WordPress version, PHP version, and active theme/plugin names.
* Plugin Details: UGCify version and non-sensitive configuration settings.
* Usage Patterns: Feature usage and in-plugin page views.
* Contact Info: Site administrator email address.

External services

This plugin connects to the following external services. No data is sent to any of these services unless you explicitly use the corresponding feature.

Meta / Instagram Graph API

Used by the Instagram integration feature to authenticate your Instagram Business account via OAuth and to fetch public posts matching your configured hashtags.

  • What is sent: During OAuth, your browser is redirected to Meta’s login page. After authorisation, the plugin exchanges an authorisation code for an access token using your site’s server. Hashtag search requests include your access token and the hashtag text.
  • When it is sent: Only when an admin connects an Instagram account or when the scheduled hashtag sync runs (requires the integration to be enabled and configured).
  • Service provider: Meta Platforms, Inc.
  • Terms of service: https://developers.facebook.com/terms/
  • Privacy policy: https://www.facebook.com/privacy/policy/

YouTube oEmbed API

Used to fetch metadata (title, thumbnail) for YouTube video URLs that are imported as video reviews.

  • What is sent: The YouTube video URL.
  • When it is sent: Only when an admin imports a YouTube video review.
  • Service provider: Google LLC
  • Terms of service: https://developers.google.com/youtube/terms/api-services-tos
  • Privacy policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

TikTok Embed

When a review contains a TikTok video URL, the frontend gallery renders it using TikTok’s standard embed player (an iframe pointing to tiktok.com/embed). No data is sent from your server; the embed loads in the visitor’s browser.

  • What is sent: The TikTok video ID is included in the embed URL loaded by the visitor’s browser.
  • When it is sent: Only when a visitor views a review that contains a TikTok video.
  • Service provider: TikTok Inc.
  • Terms of service: https://www.tiktok.com/legal/page/row/terms-of-service/en
  • Privacy policy: https://www.tiktok.com/legal/page/row/privacy-policy/en

RexTheme Update Server (Pro only)

Pro licence holders receive plugin updates from RexTheme’s own update server instead of WordPress.org, to prevent the free version from overwriting the pro version.

  • What is sent: Your licence key, plugin slug, current plugin version, and your site’s home URL.
  • When it is sent: Only when WordPress checks for plugin updates and a valid pro licence key is saved, approximately every 12 hours.
  • Service provider: RexTheme (Coderex Ltd)
  • Terms of service: https://rextheme.com/terms-and-conditions/
  • Privacy policy: https://rextheme.com/privacy-policy/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the WP Funnels to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Follow the setup wizard to configure the plugin for use
sections.faq:
Does this work with my theme?

If your theme supports WooCommerce, it supports UGC for WooCommerce. We use native WooCommerce hooks for maximum compatibility. Tested with all major themes.

Will this slow down my site?

No. We use lazy loading, image compression, and optimized database queries. Typical page speed impact is under 50ms.

Can customers upload videos?

Yes. Customers can upload both photos and videos. Supported formats include JPG, PNG, GIF, MP4, and WebM.

Do I need to manually send emails to collect UGC?

No. Post-purchase collection emails are fully automated. Set your timing preference (e.g., 7 days after delivery) and the plugin handles the rest.

Is my customer data safe?

All content is stored on your own WordPress hosting. Nothing is sent to external servers. You have full control and ownership.

Can I moderate submissions before they go live?

Absolutely. Every submission goes through your moderation dashboard first. Nothing appears on your store until you approve it.

What happens if I deactivate the plugin?

Customer photos and videos remain in your WordPress media library. Your data is never held hostage.

1.0.1 (2026-05-05)

  • Fix: Resolved API calling issue on pro features

1.0.0 (2026-05-04)

  • Initial release
  • Photo and video review collection with drag-and-drop upload
  • Shoppable UGC gallery with masonry, grid, and list layouts
  • Visual hotspot product tagger for multi-product tagging
  • Moderation dashboard with bulk actions
  • Five automated email triggers with built-in drag-and-drop editor
  • Discount coupon rewards for approved photo reviews
  • WooCommerce review migration (import and export)
  • Instagram integration via Meta OAuth
  • YouTube video URL import
  • Spam management with keyword filtering
  • Automation workflows via Mail Mint
  • Review insights dashboard with date range filtering
  • Six-step setup wizard
